digest_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 rows sorted by path: relative POSIX path, TAB, lowercase raw-file SHA256, TAB, byte length, LF
selection: Original tracked and non-ignored source additions in assets/src/scripts/tests, plus explicitly enumerated application configuration and source-text files. Source frozen by migration owner; source and destination hashes matched after copying.
excluded: credentials, keys, certificates and signing material
dependencies, caches and generated build outputs
